_meta.title: Marie site lines + reusable templates (curated voice layer)
_meta.register: personalized second-person; NOT the collective we/us Sky layer
_meta.voice_note: CONFIRMED lines excluded from tone_pass and seam/register lints

principle: Name an ordinary behavior first (overworking, staying quiet, managing someone's mood, editing a message, refusing help, keeping a failing system running). The astrology becomes powerful when it explains why that behavior is becoming impossible to continue.

families.name: The strength that has gone too far
families.pattern: Your {strength} helped you {survive/succeed/connect}, but it is now costing you {lived consequence}.

families.name: The behavior and the hidden reason
families.pattern: You have been {specific behavior} because {fear or need}. Now {concrete consequence} is becoming harder to ignore.

families.name: The body reveals the cost
families.pattern: Your body may be carrying {symptom or exhaustion} while you continue {appeasing, working, managing, or avoiding}.

families.name: The two conflicting needs
families.pattern: One side of you wants {desire}. The other is afraid of {specific cost attached to receiving it}.

families.name: The disruption as information
families.pattern: The {delay, conflict, ending, or disruption} reveals where {existing arrangement} was already failing.

families.name: The practical close
families.pattern: Choose one {conversation/task/habit/boundary}. Make it specific enough to act on before {timing marker}.

exact.text: Your value isn't up for negotiation, even in relationships where you love the other person.
exact.source: Marie Satori — Full Moon in Taurus

template.form: Your {need/value/boundary} is not up for negotiation, even in {relationship where enforcing it is difficult}.

exact.text: You've pushed past your own limits to keep things running, but exhaustion isn't a badge of honor.
exact.source: Marie Satori — Chiron Retrograde in Aries

template.form: You've pushed past {limit} to keep {responsibility} running, but {visible consequence} is catching up with you.

exact.text: One side of you wants to be seen. The other side is scared of what visibility might cost.

template.form: One side of you wants {desire}. The other is afraid of {specific cost of receiving it}.

exact.text: We have learned to voice the small preferences while hiding the big truths.

template.form: You may voice {safe preference} while continuing to hide {truth that could change the relationship}.

exact.text: What is witnessed here will shape what comes next.

template.form: What becomes clear {during this event} will shape {next phase, decision, or relationship chapter}.

exact.text: Ask yourself what could grow if you stopped managing other people's chaos.

template.form: Ask yourself what could {grow/change/be completed} if you stopped managing {problem that belongs to others}.

exact.text: Your wellness routine has become another way to fail.

template.form: Your {system intended to help} may have become another way to {judge, exhaust, or punish yourself}.

exact.text: The chaos you've been trying to prevent might have been the breakthrough you needed.
exact.source: Marie Satori — This Week's Astrology: August 30 – September 7

template.form: The {change/disruption/conversation} you have been trying to prevent may be what finally changes {stuck situation}.

exact.text: Your body has been keeping score while you've been keeping peace.
exact.source: Marie Satori — This Week's Astrology: August 30 – September 7

template.form: Your body has been carrying {physical consequence} while you have been {appeasing, accommodating, or remaining silent}.

exact.text: Even your self-care has deliverables.
exact.source: Marie Satori — Pisces Full Moon Eclipse

template.form: Even your {rest/creativity/healing/spiritual practice} has become something you expect yourself to complete correctly.

exact.text: It is revealing where your productivity has become a prison and how your responsibility to others has made you irresponsible to yourself.
exact.source: Marie Satori — Uranus Retrograde in Gemini

template.form: {Event} reveals where your {strength} has begun controlling your life and what it has caused you to neglect.

exact.text: Silence is not protection.

template.form: {Coping behavior} is not protecting you from {consequence it only postpones}.

exact.text: Stability requires maintenance.

template.form: {Relationship/stability/trust/health} requires maintenance, especially when {pressure or changing condition}.

exact.text: When Uranus moves through Taurus, money doesn't work the same way anymore.
exact.source: Marie Satori — Uranus Direct in Taurus

template.form: When {planet} moves through {sign/house}, {affected life area} does not work the same way anymore.

exact.text: This is when your words become your commitments.

template.form: This is when your {words/ideas/desires/plans} become {commitments, decisions, or consequences}.

exact.text: Your daily life is your spell. Build it to nourish, not drain.

template.form: Your {daily behavior} creates {longer-term condition}. Build it to support {need}, rather than continually draining it.

exact.text: These thought patterns have been protecting you from disappointment, but they're also protecting you from good things.
exact.source: Marie Satori — Full Moon in Aries

template.form: This {belief/defense/habit} protects you from {feared outcome} while also keeping you from {wanted experience}.

exact.text: You're being asked to match your words with your actions, your values with your commitments.

template.form: Match your {stated belief} with {observable action}, and your {value} with {commitment that proves it}.

exact.text: If you've been running yourself ragged, the eclipse will intervene.

template.form: If you have been ignoring {limit/problem}, {event or consequence} may force the pause you have avoided.

exact.text: Whether it arrives as a revelation, a confrontation, or a sudden break in the script, it forces clarity.

template.form: Whether it arrives through {possibility one}, {possibility two}, or {possibility three}, {event} makes {truth} harder to avoid.

exact.text: The harder you pushed, the less things moved.
exact.source: Marie Satori — Mars Direct in Cancer

template.form: The harder you pushed {person, decision, project, or timeline}, the less {movement or cooperation} you received.

exact.text: You don't have to keep balancing things that were never yours to juggle.

template.form: You do not have to keep managing {conflict, responsibility, or emotions} that never belonged to you.

exact.text: Your worth isn't determined by your earning capacity.
exact.source: Marie Satori — Taurus Full Moon (Aries Rising)

template.form: Your {worth/value} is not determined by {external measure}.

exact.text: Your body carries information you might not have words for yet.
exact.source: Marie Satori — Taurus Full Moon (Taurus Rising)

template.form: Your body carries {information/signal} you might not have words for yet.

exact.text: Your body knows the difference between sustainable effort and survival mode.
exact.source: Marie Satori — Taurus Full Moon (Gemini Rising)

template.form: Your body knows the difference between {sustainable version} and {survival version}.

exact.text: Let the silence hold what words can't.

template.form: Let {the pause/silence/stillness} hold what {words/fixing/explaining} can't.

exact.text: This buys you time to think about whether you can genuinely help without resenting it later.

template.form: That buys you time to decide whether you can genuinely {help/commit/say yes} without resenting it later.
